title: agropyron cristatum var. pectinatum
intro: Agropyron cristatum var. pectinatum, commonly known as Pectinate Wheatgrass, is a variety of grass that belongs to the wheatgrass family. It is valued for its nutritional and medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects. The therapeutic actions of Pectinate Wheatgrass include soothing digestive issues, supporting liver function, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pectinate Wheatgrass include vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
